001package dayplanner;
002
003import java.awt.Color;
004import java.awt.Dimension;
005import java.awt.event.WindowAdapter;
006import java.awt.event.WindowEvent;
007
008import javax.swing.BorderFactory;
009import javax.swing.BoxLayout;
010import javax.swing.JFrame;
011import javax.swing.JLabel;
012import javax.swing.JOptionPane;
013import javax.swing.border.Border;
014
015/**
016 * Represents the Swing GUI extension.
017 */
018public class GUIDayPlanner extends JFrame {
019    private static final Dimension DIMS = new Dimension(600, 200);
020        private static final String TITLE = "DayPlanner";
021        private static final int CLOSE = JFrame.DO_NOTHING_ON_CLOSE;
022        private static final Color BACKGROUND = new Color(220, 220, 220);
023    private static final Border PADDING = BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(12, 12, 12, 12);
024
025
026    /**
027     * Create a new Swing GUI window.
028     * @param activities Defined ActivityList.
029     */
030    public GUIDayPlanner(ActivityList activities) {
031        // ==============================
032        // Window Setup
033        // ==============================
034
035        super();
036        setSize(DIMS);
037        setTitle(TITLE);
038        setDefaultCloseOperation(CLOSE);
039        getContentPane().setBackground(BACKGROUND);
040        setLocationRelativeTo(null);
041        setLayout(new BoxLayout(getContentPane(), BoxLayout.X_AXIS));
042        addWindowListener(new WindowAdapter() {
043            @Override
044            public void windowClosing(WindowEvent e) {
045                showGuiQuitMenu();
046            }
047        });
048
049
050        // ==============================
051        // Contents
052        // ==============================
053
054        JLabel welcomeText = new JLabel();
055        welcomeText.setBorder(PADDING);
056        refreshWelcomeText(welcomeText, activities);
057
058        GUICommandMenu dropdown = new GUICommandMenu(this);
059        dropdown.addActionListener(e -> {
060            refreshWelcomeText(welcomeText, activities);
061        });
062
063        add(dropdown);
064        add(welcomeText);
065        
066
067        // ==============================
068        // End
069        // ==============================
070
071        setVisible(true);
072    }
073
074    /**
075     * Saves the list and exits the GUI. Shows an error message if there was an
076     * error saving the list.
077     */
078    public void quit() {
079        String errorMsg = "There was an error saving the list. Click \"OK\" to exit DayPlanner.";
080        
081        boolean errorOccurred = DayPlanner.quit();
082        dispose();
083
084        if (errorOccurred)
085            JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(
086                null, errorMsg,
087                null, JOptionPane.ERROR_MESSAGE);
088
089        System.exit(0);
090    }
091
092    /**
093     * Shows the GUI quit menu.
094     */
095    public void showGuiQuitMenu() {
096        new GUIQuitMenu(this);
097    }
098
099    /**
100     * Refresh the welcome text label.
101     * 
102     * @param welcomeText The welcome text label.
103     * @param activities  The list of activities.
104     */
105    public void refreshWelcomeText(JLabel welcomeText, ActivityList activities) {
106        String text = ("<html>"
107                    + DayPlannerUtils.getGreeting(activities.size())
108                    + "\n"
109                    + "Choose a command from the menu to the left."
110                    + "</html>")
111            .replaceAll("\n", "<br>");
112
113        welcomeText.setText(text);
114    }
115}
